identity.name: Trivia Forge
identity.emotional_archetype: The Performance Pro (with a twist of Electric & Neon)
identity.description: A trivia host's command center. Dark, sleek, high-contrast, designed for low-light venue environments.

grid_system.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 auto-rows-[180px]

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#71E0DC] to-[#AEB2EF] text-zinc-950 font-bold hover:opacity-90 transition-opacity shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(113,224,220,0.3)]

inputs.default: bg-zinc-950/50 border-white/10 focus:border-[#71E0DC] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#71E0DC]/50 transition-all placeholder:text-zinc-600

universal_guidelines: Use distinct, non-generic fonts: Manrope for headings, Inter for body.
Implement the 'Teal-to-Lavender' gradient subtly (borders, text gradients, primary buttons) rather than overwhelming backgrounds.
Prioritize high contrast in Dark Mode. Avoid pure black (#000000); use Zinc-950 (#09090B) for warmth.
Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur) for sticky headers and overlays to maintain context.
Ensure all interactive elements have a clear :hover and :focus state.
Use 1px borders with low opacity (border-white/10) to define shapes instead of heavy shadows.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for testing.
Do not use gradients for body text, only for short headings or emphasis.
Keep the interface spacious. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards instead of p-4.
Never center-align long blocks of text. Left-align for readability.
